title: pilea tetraphylla
intro: Pilea tetraphylla, commonly known as Aluminum Plant or Electric Fan Plant, is a type of flowering plant in the family Urticaceae. It is known for its attractive, fan-shaped leaves that are often used in interior design and decoration. The Pilea tetraphylla plant is believed to have various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health, due to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Pilea tetraphylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
